blurb:
With this experience (unlike some other similar, lower priced options) you get an upscale, well known, and well reviewed Myrtle Beach family photographer. The other options listed are out of state or out of country. 

This means the actual photography is sub contracted out to a photographer unknown to you, and then the company edits the photos. This creates a disconnect as the photographer is taking the photos, and someone else edits. Go with a trusted name!

At Myrtle Beach State Park, our family photography sessions aren't just about capturing images; they're about creating cherished moments. With a backdrop of pristine natural beauty, expertly captured by professional photographer Kristina Barron, we don't just take photos; we craft visual stories that immortalize the love, joy, and connection within your family. Free admission to State Park!
